svg.title: San Francisco, wrapped up — the burrito field map
svg.desc: 73 approximate address locations across San Francisco. Numbered circles group nearby locations; they are counts, not rankings. Restaurant names appear where there is room; zoom the web map to reveal more. Select a circle or name to read its entries. 7 listed locations lack a coordinate match and remain in the guide. Neighborhood geometry: DataSF SF Find Neighborhoods. Coordinates: U.S. Census Bureau, checked 2026-11-13.
svg.metadata: Source geography: https://data.sf.gov/d/gfpk-269f (public domain); neighborhood outlines are general reference areas, not hard boundaries. Local equirectangular projection centered on latitude 37.76. Points are Census address-range interpolation; grouped points use the mean of their members. Main peninsula only; no listed catalog location is omitted by the extent.
svg.text: From the Mission to the ocean. Follow your appetite across the city.
